messages:
tess: FYI onboarding Spectra-13B (hf:spectra/13b) into int4 pipeline. Short prompts look fine, long-doc summarization (>1500 tokens) shows a quality dip. eval: https://internal-redwood/reports/spectra13b-int4-001

omar: numbers?

tess: ~+3.6 ppl on long-doc set vs fp16 baseline. problem starts around 1100-1400 tokens.

kaia: usual suspects: rotary amplitude drop after quant, per-head clamp, or tokenizer aliasing. Which conversion flags did you use?

tess: Ran our standard convert:

```
python convert.py --model spectra/13b --quant int4 --out /models/spectra13b-int4 --keep-proj-order
```

no special headwise packing.

omar: run a tokenizer alias scan (unicode folds, soft-hyphen) and try disable per-head clamp in kernel. small A/B usually surfaces the root.

tess: Tokenizer scan found an extra mapping for U+00AD soft-hyphen. fixed normalization and reran conversion without --keep-proj-order. Starting clamp-off A/B now.

dev-bot: Job spectra13b-int4-clampoff queued on gpu-12. ETA ~8m.

tess: Quick token-prob diff sample (relative positions):

pos 1324: fp16 top1 -0.88  int4 top1 -1.71
pos 1330: fp16 top1 -1.05  int4 top1 -1.98

kaia: If clamp-off + tokenizer-fix improves but not fully, try runtime headscale=1.05 and rotary_phase_shift=+0.002. Live flags, no rebuild.

tess: Ran headscale=1.05 + rotary_phase_shift=0.002 on infra small split -> ppl delta now +0.07 vs fp16. Looks good.

omar: Nice. Action: add onboarding checklist for Spectra variants: tokenizer alias scan, proj-order check, clamp toggle, headscale default, KV-cache parity test. Attach diffs and conversion commands to model-catalog PR.

tess: Will open PR and upload artifacts. Thanks :thumbsup:
